label: Telecom
description: Calls to a phone, mobile or internet provider: plans, billing, outages, upgrades, new connections, roaming and cancellation.

intents.name: billing_dispute
intents.description: The customer questions a charge, a higher bill or a double payment.
intents.guidance: Ask for the bill month and the amount in question, explain the charge if it is known, and offer a review instead of promising a refund.

intents.name: plan_change
intents.description: The customer wants to upgrade, downgrade or change a plan or data pack.
intents.guidance: Ask about their usage (data, calls, roaming) and suggest the plan that fits; confirm price and start date only if known.

intents.name: network_issue
intents.description: No signal, dropped calls, slow mobile data or an internet outage.
intents.guidance: Ask the location, since when, and whether one device or all are affected; check for a known outage before device troubleshooting.

intents.name: cancellation
intents.description: The customer wants to cancel, port out or switch provider.
intents.guidance: Ask the main reason first and address it if possible; then explain the process and any contract terms without pressure.

intents.name: new_connection
intents.description: The customer wants a new SIM, line, broadband connection or a move to a new address.
intents.guidance: Confirm the address or area and the type of connection, then the documents needed.

intents.name: roaming
intents.description: Questions about using the phone abroad.
intents.guidance: Ask the destination and travel dates and suggest activating a roaming pack before travel.

intents.name: general
intents.description: Anything else: greetings, verification or unclear lines.
intents.guidance: Suggest the next useful question that identifies the account and the customer's need.

facts.description: Account or customer ID (last digits only)
The plan or package the customer has now, e.g. prepaid, postpaid, fibre 100
The main problem in a few words
Area or city where the problem happens
